newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Telstra bill due this week - govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Telstra bill due this week - govt.

text.p: The Australian government expects a final Senate vote this week on its plan to sell a third of telecoms carrier Telstra Corp, a spokesman for Communications Minister Richard Alston said on Monday.
"We will seek a vote this week," the spokesman said.
In a preliminary schedule for the upper house of parliament this week, the government listed the Telstra (Dilution of Public Ownership) Bill for debate on Tuesday.
It need not, however, stick to the schedule and the bill is competing for Senate time with the government's budget bills, which aim to slash the budget deficit.

The government is two votes short of a majority in the Senate and among non-government senators all but two Independents have vowed to vote against the sale, which is expected to raise around A$8 billion.
